exposure: neonatal outcome (stillbirth, neonatal death, NICU admission, normal)
normal term pregnancy and normal outcome after vaginal delivery
admission to level 3 neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The cohort consisted of placentas from 55 antepartum stillbirths, 21 intrapartum stillbirths, 12 neonatal deaths, 80 admissions to a level 3 neonatal intensive care unit, 439 neonates from normal term pregnancies and normal outcome after vaginal delivery, and 105 neonates born after elective caesarean section.
finding: Multiple placental abnormalities are significantly more frequent in placentas from term neonates with severe perinatal morbidity and mortality.
